description: Screening project economics for a battery at an ERCOT node or the node nearest a point of interconnection: a 24-month (12 to 36) backcast of day-ahead energy arbitrage and ancillary capacity revenue from real ERCOT prices, then capex split into a power part ($/kW) and an energy part ($/kWh) with editable defaults from NREL's 2025 utility-scale battery cost update (2026 mid case, 2024 dollars), fixed O&M, degradation, land and interconnection costs you enter, and a 20-year unlevered pre-tax cash flow with simple payback and IRR that holds the backcast revenue flat. History, not a forecast. Use for 'what would a 100 MW / 400 MWh battery here pencil to', 'payback for a battery at this node', 'battery IRR'. Enterprise.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

as_share.description: Share of MW offered to ancillary services, 0 to 1. Default 0.

capex_energy_usd_per_kwh.description: Energy-related capex, USD per kWh. Default 222 (same source, energy share).

capex_power_usd_per_kw.description: Power-related capex, USD per kW. Default 343 (NREL 2025 update, 2026 mid, power share).

cod_year.description: First operating year for the forward cases. Default next year.

curve.description: Name of a forward curve the account uploaded on the map; adds a custom case.

fom_pct_of_capex.description: Fixed O&M per year as a percent of capex. Default 4 (NREL).

interconnection_usd.description: Interconnection cost the project pays: project substation, gen-tie, switching station share. Default 0 (not included).

land_usd.description: Land purchase cost, USD. Default 0 (not included).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

mwh.description: Energy in MWh. Default 4 x MW.

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point instead of a location.

target_irr_pct.description: Target unlevered IRR for the tolling breakeven. Default 8.

name: battery_economics
title: Battery project economics: revenue backcast, costs, payback and IRR
